- requirement: "After a rollback, neither `auto-release-stable.yml` nor the `promote-main-to-stable.yml` cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately. The release job clears the hold when it publishes." Also: "so none can move the tag forward again after the rollback."
  expected_change_site: the `promote` job of `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` (the step that validates `TARGET_SHA_INPUT`, around lines 211-258), or the poller dispatch with `target_sha` in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` contains no `stable_hold` reference, and its `promote` job (lines 39-47 and 211-258) fast-forwards `stable` and runs the release gate without reading the hold. The hold check exists only in `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`, at `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:701-721`, which runs only from the scheduled `cycle` job (line 153). `scripts/rollback_stable.sh:399-421` ends its drain at the first clean poll (`[ "${still_active}" -eq 0 ] && break`) and then re-writes the hold, pushes tags and dispatches to consumers. Nothing cancels runs dispatched during that window, so a poller-dispatched `promote` can release, clear the hold and re-ship the rolled-back tag. `README.md:4774-4785` and `agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md` document this as a known gap whose only mitigation is an operator removing a label by hand. Severity disagreement: sonnet, minimax and glm rate it MAJOR; gemini rates it NIT and says it is not an intent gap because the issue's approach scoped the hold to the scheduled `cycle` job. Sonnet and glm also note that neither `promote-main-to-stable.yml` nor `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` is in the issue's `files_touched` grant, that §18.E names only `promote_main_cycle.sh` as the promote-side hold reader, and that prior editor rounds deferred this item. They recommend a follow-up issue instead of an edit in this PR.
- requirement: "Every outcome is logged under a stable prefix and sent to Telegram as CRITICAL."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml`, Telegram configuration for the rollback step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow passes `TG_BOT_SECRET` and `TG_ADMIN_CHAT_ID` without requiring either to be configured (`.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml:72-73`). When either is empty, `tg_send_msg` returns success without sending (`scripts/tg_helpers.sh:120-121`), so rollback outcomes can complete without the required Telegram alert.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
